Design Details   Red Team Knowledge Construction: Although several works have studied the term “jailbreak strategy” [51], [52], they model jailbreak strategies as static, semantic features of existing jail- break templates and classify existing jailbreak prompts into fewer categories of jailbreak strategies, few work study how to sufficiently leverage the flexible nature of these strategies to design red teaming approaches.
